subject: Bar widths not equal and error bars not dodging the same.

messages.subject: Bar widths not equal and error bars not dodging the same.
parts:
Hello,

I'm new to ggplot2 and in fact this is the first plot I've attempted.
So far the package looks great, but I've ran into a few troubles
completing my chart.

I've got a plot with Year on the X axis and Percent Cover of Grass
for each study area on the Y axis. This plots fine but some of my bars
are not showing up the same width (depsite the fact I think I've set
the width setting). For example most years have multiple study areas
sampled, but 2005 only has one site sampled so its bar width is much
larger than the rest.

Additionally, I've added error bars and tried to dodge them to line up
with my bars but for some reason they are not lining up properly with
me bars.

My code is below. I apologize if I've failed to post the approriate
info to diagnose this issue, but I'm new to R and this group. Thanks
in advance.

> library(RODBC)
> channel <- odbcConnect("UWRR")
> sqlTables(channel, tableType="TABLE")
> Cover<-sqlFetch(channel,"AnalysisTbl_Qry_Forage_Abund_ForbGrassPercentCover_1sqm_Plots")
> Cover
> attach(Cover)
> Natural_subregion
[1] Montane Montane Montane Montane Montane
[6] Montane Montane Montane Montane Montane
[11] Montane Montane Subalpine Subalpine Subalpine
[16] Subalpine Subalpine Subalpine Subalpine Subalpine
Levels: Montane Subalpine
> Year
[1] 2006 2007 2008 2010 2006 2007 2008 2010 2006 2007 2008 2010 2005
2007 2008
[16] 2011 2008 2011 2008 2011
>AvgOfGrassPerCov
[1] 4.200000 2.150000 4.275000 4.400000 6.533333
[6] 3.900000 3.315789 3.842105 7.866667 5.175000
[11] 10.184211 9.225000 6.250000 2.300000 1.263158
[16] 5.675676 4.416667 3.526316 5.575000 3.052632
> CountOfGrassPerCov
[1] 30 40 40 40 30 40 38 38 30 40 38 40 40 40 38 37 36 38 40 38
> StdErrorGrass
[1] 1.5360795 0.5045308 1.5262605 1.5020499 2.9636624 0.5439646
0.8700037 0.7357236 1.9720655 1.2444170 2.5709990
[12] 2.2830163 0.8724781 0.3166329 0.2464087 1.1798191 1.3203986
0.9724051 1.3329587 0.5333106

> library(ggplot2)

> p <- ggplot(Cover, aes(x=Year, y=AvgOfGrassPerCov,label = "Study Area",fill = Study_Area_Code))+ylab("Average Percent Cover of Grass")

> q <- p+geom_bar(stat = "identity", binwidth = 0.2, position = "dodge") + opts(title = "Average Percent Cover of Grass in 1msq Plots",plot.title = theme_text(size =20),panel.background = theme_blank())

> r <-q + facet_grid(. ~ Natural_subregion)

> x<-r+scale_fill_grey()+geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=AvgOfGrassPerCov-StdErrorGrass, ymax =AvgOfGrassPerCov+StdErrorGrass, position = "dodge",width=0.25))
> x

Tried the following to add the count number as a label as well but it
reformats the chart to only show the count numbers and can’t see the
bars anymore. Ideally I want the label of each bar to say n=
CountofGrassPerCov (e.g. n = 40)
y <-x + geom_text(aes(CountOfGrassPerCov, label = CountOfGrassPerCov,
position = "dodge"))

messages.subject: Re: Bar widths not equal and error bars not dodging the same.
parts:
I managed to figure out the dodging issue of the error bars by adding
in a line adjusting the dodge position by a factor of 0.5. I was also
missing a bracket. So the updated error bar code reads:
geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=AvgOfGrassPerCov-StdErrorGrass, ymax
=AvgOfGrassPerCov+StdErrorGrass),
size =.3,
width =.3,
position = position_dodge(0.5))

I am still having issues with the bar widths not staying the same
between all the Years of data. As discussed before years that only
contain data for one study area are wider than years that have
multiple study areas sampled in the year. So in effect the bar width
for site TCA in 2005 is the same width size as the small bar widths of
sites TCA,TCC,TCD combined.

My updated reformated code is below:

p <- ggplot(data=Cover, aes(x=factor(Year), y=AvgOfGrassPerCov, fill =
Study_Area_Code)) +
# add bar geometry, setting stat to identity, width, and dodged
position
geom_bar(width = 0.5, position = position_dodge()) +
# add y label
ylab("Average Percent Cover of Grass") +
xlab("Year")+
# add title options and size and set background to white
opts(title = "Average Percent Cover of Grass in 1 sqm Plots
\n",plot.title = theme_text(size =14),panel.background = theme_blank())
+
# Set to grayscale
scale_fill_grey()+
# add error bar from standard error
geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=AvgOfGrassPerCov-StdErrorGrass, ymax
=AvgOfGrassPerCov+StdErrorGrass),
size =.3,
width =.3,
position = position_dodge(0.5))+
# add facet to seperate by subregion
facet_grid(Natural_subregion ~ .)


Any suggestions how to change the bar widths so they are all the same
width regardless if a year has multiple bars (i.e. sites) or a single
bar.

Thanks in advance.
